name: meta-interest-finder
description: Search Meta ad interests and build an audience shortlist, without shipping a token.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json --noEmit && npm run check:api && vite build
scripts.check:api: node --check api/_lib.js && node --check api/status.js && node --check api/interests.js && node --check api/mcp.js
